(rule!
  (let* ((completed (let ((dummy 0)) (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (- (rows g) 1))) (c (in-range (- (cols g) 1)))) (let* ((cells (list (list r c (at g r c)) (list r (+ c 1) (at g r (+ c 1))) (list (+ r 1) c (at g (+ r 1) c)) (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1) (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))) (vals (map third cells)) (nz (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) vals))) (if (and (= (length nz) 3) (= (length (remove-duplicates nz)) 1) (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 0)) vals) 1)) (let ((miss (first (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) 0)) cells)))) (set-cell out (first miss) (second miss) (first nz))) out)))))
         (src completed))
    (define (solid-color r c)
      (let ((v (at src r c)))
        (if (and (not (= v 0))
                 (= (at src r (+ c 1)) v)
                 (= (at src (+ r 1) c) v)
                 (= (at src (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) v))
            v
            0)))
    (for*/fold ((out completed))
               ((r (in-range (- (rows src) 1)))
                (c (in-range (- (cols src) 1))))
      (let ((color (solid-color r c)))
        (if (= color 0)
            out
            (for*/fold ((acc out))
                       ((rr (in-range (max 0 (- r 1))
                                      (min (rows src) (+ r 3))))
                        (cc (in-range (max 0 (- c 1))
                                      (min (cols src) (+ c 3)))))
              (if (= (at acc rr cc) 0)
                  (set-cell acc rr cc color)
                  acc)))))))
